headline: The biggest games coming next
title: Biggest Upcoming Games | CoD MW4, Phantom Blade Zero, Zelda, GTA 6 | Gaming News
video_script: Here are the biggest games coming in the next few weeks! October twenty third, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. October twenty ninth, Phantom Blade Zero. November fifth, the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2. And November nineteenth, the biggest game of the year, GTA 6! Which one are you waiting for the most? Comment below!
